subject.title: fix(chutes): add timeouts to OAuth HTTP requests

question: Should Chutes plugin OAuth token and userinfo requests fail after a 30s request deadline by default?
rationale: The patch fixes indefinite auth hangs, but intentionally changes existing Chutes login behavior from unbounded provider HTTP waits to a fail-closed deadline.

options.title: Accept the 30s deadline
options.body: Land the current behavior because it bounds Chutes auth hangs and matches the shared OAuth request-timeout pattern.

options.title: Tune the deadline first
options.body: Ask for a different Chutes-specific default while preserving the shared helper and regression tests.

options.title: Pause for live latency proof
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers see provider-specific OAuth latency evidence for the chosen deadline.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30s deadline
recommendation.body: Land the current behavior because it bounds Chutes auth hangs and matches the shared OAuth request-timeout pattern.
